qualification_scope: Runtime self-test receipts bind the exact selected Lima workload transport; evidence verification, interrupted-run recovery, CLI design simulation and web simulation fail closed when that transport is omitted or changed.

openrtl-primary-checkout.resolution: Resolve against the primary checkout; retained artifacts are local and not distributed.

qualification_limits: The owner-offline gate exercised deterministic fixtures only; it did not contact a provider, daemon or Lima guest and did not mutate a saved customer project.

Transport identity is content-addressed from the reviewed Lima executable path and bytes, private state root and exact managed instance name; a host-local or different guest receipt cannot authorize execution.
The runtime status command rehashes saved evidence but deliberately restores neither transport choice nor execution authority.
The live simulator image, rootless daemon, Lima lifecycle and one transport-bound infrastructure self-test remain unqualified by this implementation evidence.
Detailed telemetry, strict deterministic validation, provider compatibility checks and existing security boundaries remain enabled and unchanged.
